IN pursuance of the provisions of clause (3) of Article 348 of the Constitution of India, the
Governor is pleased to order the publication of the following English translation of notification no. 877/IX-
2–2020-09(Seema Vistar)-2008, dated December 23, 2020 :
No. 877/IX-2–2020-09(Seema Vistar)-2008
Dated Lucknow, December 23, 2020
WHEREAS notification no.774/IX-2-2020-09(Seema Vistar)-2008, dated November 26, 2020 was
published to invite objections and suggestions for including the areas specified in Schedule I below in the
smaller urban area of Municipal Council Bijnor, District Bijnor as required under sub-section (2) of section
4 of the Uttar Pradesh Municipalities Act, 1916 (U.P. Act no. II of 1916), hereinafter referred to as the
said act;
AND, WHEREAS, the objections and suggestion received in pursuance of the said notification has
been disposed of by Government order no. 851/IX-2-2020-09(Seema Vistar)-2008, dated December 18,
2020;
NOW, THEREFORE, in exercise of the powers under clause (2) of Article 243-Q of the Constitution
of India read with sub-section (2) of section 3 of the said act, the Governor is pleased to include the area
specified in Schedule-I below in the smaller urban area of Municipal Council Bijnor, District Bijnor for the
purposes of Part IX-A of the Constitution of India and to direct under clause (d) of Article 243-P of the
Constituion of India that the areas specified in Schedule II shall be the territorial area of Municipal
Council Bijnor, District Bijnor.
